Meet Soyli

A creative who thinks like a strategist — and delivers like a founder.

About me

Hi, I'm Soyli — I don't just make things look good, I make them perform.

Give me a niche and I'll take it apart, find the angle nobody else is using, and turn it into a funnel that actually moves — a sharp marketing plan, scroll-stopping visuals, high-end motion, and Meta ad campaigns built to convert.

Strategist's brain, designer's eye, and a founder's obsession with results — with AI in my corner so it all ships fast.

Why hire me

I don't sell artwork. I sell your next quarter's results.

Everything below is built around one question that founders and HR teams actually care about: how does this move the business forward?

01
The difference

Every detail is justified.

I can defend every design decision, discuss ideas strategically, and create scroll-stopping property and B2B ads using the latest trends — never decoration for its own sake.

Strategic Trend-aware Defensible
02

Client-centric, not portfolio-centric

I solve real problems for founders and HR teams, prioritizing your future business results over showing off past artwork.

03

Speed & AI innovation

I work faster and more creatively than traditional designers — generating initial concepts with AI, then redesigning them for maximum impact.

04

Professional reliability

Strict time management, deadlines respected, and step-by-step transparency at every stage of the work — the person leadership relies on to deliver.

How I work

Four clear phases — from first analysis to live ad spend.

Every project follows the same transparent path. You always know which phase we're in, what happens next, and exactly what you receive at the end of each one.

1
Phase 01

Analyze

I study your business, vision and niche — plus your competitors — so the plan is built on facts, not guesses.

You get: a clear picture of where you stand.
2
Phase 02

Plan

I build a full content plan and show leadership exactly how each asset will drive growth and output quality.

You get: a content roadmap tied to results.
3
Phase 03

Execute

I produce daily content — motion and static — polished and ready to publish, right on schedule.

You get: scroll-stopping creative, daily.
4
Phase 04

Distribute

I set up and optimize targeted ads on Instagram, Facebook and Google with precise audiences and budgets.

You get: high-converting campaigns, live.

Automation · n8n

I don't just run marketing — I automate it.

I build AI workflows in n8n. My AI Marketing Agent takes a single business, analyzes it along with its competitors and its niche, then returns a ready-to-use marketing funnel, a promotion planner, and the first 10 concrete steps to start growing — automatically.

AI Marketing Agent — live workflow in n8n
What the agent delivers
Business analysis
Reads the website & offer to understand the business.
Competitor analysis
Maps who they're up against and where the gaps are.
Niche insight
Positions the brand within its market.
Funnel + promotion planner
A complete funnel and a ready promotion plan.
The first 10 steps
Concrete actions to start growing today.
How it runs

Built end-to-end in n8n and powered by Google Gemini. One request in — a full, structured growth report out as a document.

New Analysis Request→ Fetch Website→ Extract Text→ Business Analyst→ Competitor Analyst→ Funnel Architect→ Promotion Planner→ Assemble Report→ Create Document
Powered by Google Gemini · orchestrated in n8n
Outreach & social proof

If your brand isn't on social media, you're leaving growth on the table. Brands with an active online presence grow and win clients [X]% faster — let's make sure yours is one of them.
